name: External FPP Web Access
author: jessica12ryan
description: Open a secondary (external) password-protected web address for FPP. Visitors log in with their own username and password (multi-user with Admin/User roles) before reaching your dashboard, so you can share your FPP UI without exposing your internal FPP UI. Works great behind NGINX Proxy Manager and uses only what's already built into FPP.

privacy.summary: Adds a password-protected copy of the FPP web interface on extra ports. When you check public access it asks online services for your public address and whether the port is reachable.
